name: Park Jae-Hyun
bio:
Park Jae-Hyun's journey into motorsport HR was unconventional. He initially studied engineering, but a passion for team dynamics led him to pursue a master's in organizational psychology. After a stint in a corporate environment, the thrill of racing called, and he transitioned into motorsport, drawn by the high-pressure, collaborative atmosphere. His engineering background gives him a unique perspective when assessing technical roles within the team.

Park is a firm believer in fostering a supportive and inclusive environment within Hot Racing Team. He prioritizes clear communication, professional development opportunities, and employee well-being. He’s known for his approachable demeanor and commitment to resolving conflicts fairly and efficiently. His goal is to ensure every team member feels valued and empowered to contribute their best.

What sets Park apart is his commitment to continuous improvement. He actively seeks feedback, attends industry conferences, and incorporates new HR best practices to maintain a cutting-edge approach to people management. He's also a skilled mediator, adept at navigating complex interpersonal dynamics within the team.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly parted on the side with a slight wave
physical.description: Park is of average height with a kind, intelligent face often creased in a smile.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook to jot down observations about team dynamics
Has a habit of offering employees Korean snacks during stressful periods
Organizes informal team-building exercises disguised as 'cultural exchange' events
